deadline.value: The fall deadline is December 1, 2026, for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: December 1 Final Deadline to Apply for Fall Admission

gre_general.value: The admissions page says GRE scores are not required (an older FAQ sets a quantitative minimum; see notes).
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required, but we invite applicants to report these scores if they are available.

toefl_min.value: The school minimum is 80 on the original iBT scale, or 4 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score for admission is 80 (original TOEFL iBT score scale) or 4.0 (new TOEFL iBT score scale beginning January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: The school minimum is 7.0 overall on IELTS.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum IELTS score for admission is 7.0.

supervisor.value: Applicants do not need a lab position before admission.
supervisor.quote: Applicants do not need to arrange a position in a laboratory prior to admission.

funding.value: Every applicant is considered for scholarships and assistantships, which are highly competitive.
funding.quote: The awarding of scholarships/assistantships is highly competitive

also.quote: All program applicants will be considered for scholarships/assistantships; no additional application is needed.

entry_route.value: A master's in a quantitative field is listed as a prerequisite, alongside a bachelor's with set coursework.
entry_route.quote: A master’s degree from an accredited college or university, with a minimum GPA of 3.0, in: Biostatistics, Statistics or Mathematics

notes: The GRE page says scores are not required, but the prospective FAQ lists a minimum quantitative GRE of 155 (new) or 700 (old). The two official pages conflict; confirm with the program.
name: PhD in Biostatistics
